summary: Max Verstappen arrives at Malaysia's sweltering Bahrain Grand Prix armed with Red Bull's transformative upgrade package and pole position, leaving even Lewis Hamilton bracing for another dominant weekend from the reigning champion. George Russell and Charles Leclerc identified the Milton Keynes team as the decisive force in Friday practice, setting up a battle for second between Mercedes and Ferrari in brutal heat conditions. A commanding Verstappen victory would extend his championship cushion considerably, while any slip-up could hand Hamilton or Leclerc a crucial opportunity to claw back points in this third heat-hazard designation of 2026.
